about: Synthetic products bussard refuses to flash, each the finding of an open issue (#604). The synthetic sim loop (crates/bussard-cli/tests/it/sim_catalog_loop.rs) accepts the refusal when its text contains `contains`, and fails once the product flashes, so the entry is dropped with the fix. An entry with a `note` is a product knx-sim has no profile for (the loop skips its mask); it goes when the sim models the mask.

M-00FA_A-2A24-10-0000.note: no knx-sim profile for RF mask 27B0, not a bussard refusal; bussard plans it (flash --dry-run), and ETS will not place it on the sweep's TP line
